author: Ariadne II
title: Analysis v4: SOTA Learnable-γ Seed Summary (mean±sd from exports)
abstract: CPU-only test that reads fourier_learn_gamma_export_v2/trial_{42..45}.json, aggregates val_mae across seeds, and writes mean±sd plus per-seed values to storage/ariadne/analyses/ariadne2_sota_gamma_seed_summary.md.

original_submission.content:
import os, glob, json, numpy as np

def test():
    os.makedirs("storage/ariadne/analyses", exist_ok=True)
    paths = sorted(glob.glob("storage/ariadne/analyses/fourier_learn_gamma_export_v2/trial_*.json"))
    vals = []
    rows = ["# SOTA Learnable-γ Seed Summary", "", "| seed | val_mae |", "|---:|---:|"]
    for p in paths:
        with open(p, "r") as f:
            d = json.load(f)
        seed = d.get("seed", "n/a")
        v = float(d.get("val_mae"))
        vals.append(v)
        rows.append(f"| {seed} | {v:.6f} |")
    if vals:
        arr = np.array(vals, dtype=float)
        rows.append("")
        rows.append(f"mean = {arr.mean():.6f}")
        rows.append(f"std  = {arr.std(ddof=1):.6f}" if arr.size >= 2 else f"std  = 0.000000")
    out = "\n".join(rows) + "\n"
    out_path = "storage/ariadne/analyses/ariadne2_sota_gamma_seed_summary.md"
    with open(out_path, "w") as f:
        f.write(out)
    print(out)
    print(f"[saved] {out_path}")
    return "ok"
